title: Render a Dispatch door block in the session preamble and compaction re-injection
judge_obligation_ack: Independent bee-review read of the diff is dispatched by the orchestrator at cap; small lane kept because the block is additive text with no guard logic change.
action:
In build_session_preamble (budget.rs), right after the 'Standard commands (host project)' block and before command_surface_section(), push a new section:
### Dispatch door
- Every subagent/worker dispatch starts with `.bee/bin/bee dispatch prepare --runtime claude --kind cell|gather|reviewer|advisor --json` — run the exact tool+payload it returns; never hand-pick subagent_type, model, or a [bee-tier] marker.
- Tier slots (claude): generation=<x> | extraction=<x> | review=<x> | advisor=<x>
where <x> is the model name for a model slot, `herding (<agent>)` for a {kind:herding} slot (agent field if present), `cli` for a cli slot, `native:<m>` for a native slot, and `session default` when null/unset (review falls back to generation the same way model_guard::resolve_tier does; advisor unset = `none`). Read the slots from config.models (the config Value build_session_preamble already has). Reuse model_guard's parsing: add ONE pub(crate) helper in model_guard.rs (e.g. `pub(crate) fn tier_slot_display(models_raw: Option<&Value>, runtime: &str) -> Vec<(&'static str, String)>`) built on its existing parse/resolve fns, and call it from both places — no second parser that can drift. Add the same two-line block to compaction.rs right after item 10 (Standard commands) as item 10c so a compacted session keeps the door. Add tests in session_preamble/tests.rs: (1) a herding generation slot renders `generation=herding (agy-flash)` and the prepare line; (2) a model slot renders the model name; (3) no models key renders `session default` for every tier slot. Keep the closing trailer bytes untouched (tests pin ends_with). Commit once with subject in imperative mood.

truths: The preamble shows the prepare command before any dispatch can happen
Slot display comes from model_guard's own resolver, not a second parser
